name: SCN4A (HYPP)
summary: SCN4A (HYPP), periodic paralysis - the first locus that is BOTH a survivable disorder and a lethal. One copy affects the horse (there is no silent carrier), two kill the foal. Wild horses can be born with one copy, because a dominant that never appeared in a founder could never appear at all.

phenotypes.name: Wild type
phenotypes.description: Two working copies. Nothing is wrong and nothing is passed on.

phenotypes.name: HYPP (periodic paralysis)
phenotypes.description: A sodium-channel defect. The muscle locks up in episodes the horse cannot control - it tires early, moves stiffly and jumps badly, and one copy is enough to cause it.

phenotypes.name: HYPP (two copies)
phenotypes.description: Two copies of the defect. The foal cannot breathe reliably from the moment it is born and does not survive it.
